name: turbojet_afterburner
title: Turbojet with afterburner (exercise)
summary: Station-by-station ideal-gas turbojet with an afterburner (post-combustion) section behind the turbine: polytropic component efficiencies, combustor and afterburner efficiencies, constant cold-side and hot-side specific heats. Returns the specific thrust, the fuel-air ratios and the specific fuel consumption, and reproduces the original study of the afterburner exit temperature on thrust and consumption.

verification.summary: Compared with the stored solution of THD10_R07_E6.EES after hand conversion of kPa/kJ (compare_solution.py --ees-units): 45 common variables, 11 differ (rtol=0.001), all temperatures kept in kelvin, each difference exactly 273.15; in kelvin they agree within 3.8e-09, largest relative difference on the other variables 7.607708e-09 (p0[5]).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermodynamique appliquee/2022-2023/R6/autres exo/THD10_R07_E6.EES (EES X8.423)
verification.notes: compare_solution.py --ees-units: 45 common variables, 11 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 15; only in CoolSolve: 2. The 11 differences are T[1], T_amb, T0[1..7] and T_pc: the model keeps kelvin (T_amb = -40+273) and --ees-units subtracts 273.15 from a unit of K when the name starts with T; maximum relative difference 1.172318 = 273.15/233 on T[1] and T_amb. Compared in kelvin the temperatures agree within 3.8e-09; the largest relative difference on the other common variables is 7.607708e-09 on p0[5]. Only in EES: m, n, p[2], p[3], p[4], p[6], q_m_e, s[1..4], T[2], T[3], T[4], T[6] (variable-window entries absent from the equation window). Only in CoolSolve: Cs (not stored by EES) and fluid$. All 47 equations satisfied (max relative error 2.0e-16).
